spanish: Y hizo masaj a la abertura de la tienda, azul y púrpura y carmesí y lino fino retorcido, obra de bordador,

findings.issue: Common noun (masculine singular absolute) is dumped untranslated as masaj; it is not a proper name.
Lemma 8336 b and the morph (cardinal feminine singular) leave the sense open; lino fino resolves that as fine linen and adds fineness.
Construct pair is collapsed to one color noun, so both tokens are not kept visible.

notes: Y hizo, a la abertura de la tienda, azul, púrpura, retorcido, and obra de bordador match the qal 3ms, the preposition plus definite construct, the color nouns, the hophal passive, and the construct plus qal participle.
